blocks.text: ESTATE CLEANOUT FAQ
Estate Cleanout in Vaughan — Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: How much does an estate cleanout cost in Vaughan?
a: Estate cleanout pricing is set by truck volume: small cleanouts start at $125, larger estates or condo suites scale openly with what their contents fill. The exact figure is written free at the walkthrough — sorting, carrying, hauling and every disposal fee inside — and it holds to the invoice, with no adjustment for property type or address.

items.q: What does an estate cleanout include?
a: A full estate cleanout covers sorting every room, setting aside keepsakes and valuables for the family, donating or recycling what has life left, hauling and responsibly disposing of the rest, and leaving the property broom-swept. Documentation of the donation and disposal split is available for the estate file.

items.q: How discreet is an estate cleanout on a larger Kleinburg property?
a: Completely, by design. Arrival times arrange around the family’s schedule, nothing is staged where the road can see it, and no client’s property is discussed with anyone outside the job. The family decides when — or whether — anything is announced.

items.q: Can you handle an estate cleanout in our VMC condo?
a: By the building’s book, every time. Certificates of insurance go to management at booking, the freight elevator books ahead, and hallways and common areas get protected throughout — an estate cleanout that clears without a single note for the concierge.

items.q: How do you handle an estate cleanout after a loss?
a: Gently, and at your pace. Keepsakes, photographs, documents and valuables get set aside for the family before and during the clearing — anything meaningful that surfaces comes to you, never a bin by default.

items.q: Our estate includes a family business — can you clear that alongside the home?
a: Yes, and it’s regular work for us in Vaughan. Equipment, inventory and paperwork sort with the same care as the family home, anything meaningful gets set aside before anything moves to disposal or a buyer, and the space hands over swept for whoever’s next.

items.q: What happens if you find money, jewellery or important documents?
a: They come straight to you or the executor, every time. Estate cleanouts regularly surface cash, jewellery and papers in unexpected places — our crews are trained to slow down exactly there, and the find-and-set-aside habit is non-negotiable.

items.q: Do you work with executors who live out of town or overseas?
a: Regularly. Photographs, written updates and a documented record of anything donated, recycled or set aside let an executor approve every stage of the estate cleanout remotely, without needing to be on site.

items.q: Why are your estate cleanout rates 30–50% below the national brands?
a: No franchise royalty inside the quote and no postal-code padding either — we’re local and independent, with our own trucks and crews. The identical estate cleanout, whatever the property type, simply costs less.
